caseNameFull: Darnall Trucking Co., Inc. v. Simpson, State Road Commissioner
attorneys: Messrs. Robert G. Kelly and Edmund M. Brady for appellants. Messrs. Clarence W. Meadoios, Attorney General of West Virginia, and Robert S. Spilman for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question. Maurer v. Hamilton, 309 U. S. 598.
